Kwikset 699DA, Dakota Dummy Cylinder Handleset

Security with flair, the clean lines of the Dakota Handle lends a casual ambiance to your entry door. The Dakota 898DA Dummy Handle has a Lifetime warranty on the finish. This handle is made by Kwikset who has been a leader in the residential door hardware for more than 60 years. Dummy Handles do not function and are usually used as pulls to match trim on the inactive side of double doors. This one piece oval mount handle makes it great for traditional decor.

Dummy Handleset: is for looks only. It does not lock and do not latch. Dummy handlesets are used as pulls or to match trim on double doors.

Also Available: Single Cylinder Dakota Handleset

Features of the Dakota 699DA Two Piece Dummy Entrance Set:

  • Sold as a complete set.
  • Easy to install.
  • Manufacture Lifetime Mechanical & Finish Warranty.

Specifications for the Oval Dakota Handleset:

  • Overall Length: 17-5/8"
  • Exterior Grip Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Deadbolt Crossbore: 2-1/8" or 1-1/2"
  • Handle Crossbore: 2-1/8"
  • Handing: please specify

This handleset is customisable with a huge selection of interior trim knobs and levers and additional finish color options just contact us for all the options!

The inside trim will match the outside handleset's finish.
